operating_contract_append: Stop and HOLD the protocol when an assessor safety incident or adverse sensory event is recorded.
When repeatability is required, require a declared maximum within-assessor repeat spread and audit every assessor against it.
evidence_refs_append: ISO 8586:2023 assessor selection and training scope

facts_append: The protocol requires repeatability and declares a maximum within-assessor repeat spread of 1.0 scale point.

case_overrides.target_identity: Respond to a blinded temporal evaluation after an assessor reports an immediate adverse sensory event.
facts: One assessor reported an immediate headache while evaluating sample BLIND-B.
The incident was recorded before the remaining endpoint comparisons were completed.
No continuation or interpretation after the incident was authorized.
case_overrides.expected_decision: HOLD: stop the sensory protocol, preserve the incident, and do not promote the incomplete evidence.
